instruction: Extract from the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov week 1.pdf the billing details: per-day line items with date, hours or start/end times, amounts, total, and invoice period. Query: invoice line items for Ana Ruiz, Nov week 1.

List cameras and find the Front Door camera id. Then run ug-surveillance event-timeline for Front Door, topic Human, start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00, end-time 2026-11-08T23:59:59, timezone America/New_York, identity-type all, limit 200. Return per-day events with times and identity if known.
ug-document extract --file "Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov week 1.pdf" --query "billed days, hours, and amounts" --schema "{invoice_period, line_items:[{date, hours, start_time, end_time, amount}], total}"

ug-surveillance event-timeline --location "Front Door" --topic HumanFace --identity-type known --person-name "Ana Ruiz" --start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00 --end-time 2026-11-08T23:59:59 --timezone America/New_York --limit 200
